description: Comprehensive multi-client implementation parity and deviation matrix for yEnc Body and Control Lines Encryption Standards across Pesto, Penne, SABnzbd, and NZBGet.

behaviors.name: NZB Explicit Transport Encryption Provenance Marker
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Section 8 documents <meta type="password"> for decryption passwords but omits <meta type="yenc_encrypted">.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Emits `<meta type="yenc_encrypted">true</meta>` in `<nzb><head>` whenever transport encryption is enabled.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Parses `yenc_encrypted` meta tag into `NzbMetadata.yenc_encrypted`; gates transport decryption strictly when this flag is true.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Parses `<meta type="yenc_encrypted">true</meta>` in `nzbparser.py` and sets `NZBObject.yenc_encrypted = True`. Decouples wire decryption from archive unrar.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: SAX parses `meta` tag with `type="yenc_encrypted"` and sets `m_yencEncryptedMeta = true` in `NzbFile.cpp`.
rejected_forms: Omitted tag (defaults to false / ordinary yEnc)
Non-true text values ('false', '0', 'yes')
behaviors.security_impact: Prevents unencrypted NZBs with archive passwords from triggering transport decryption errors and prevents downgrade attacks.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 8 / yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard Section 8

behaviors.name: Byte-for-Byte Dual-Salt Cross-Header Equality
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Control lines spec defines 16-byte Alphabet salt in Line 1; Body spec defines 32-hex salt in =yencryption. Does not mandate equality when both active.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Generates one 16-byte random salt per session and emits identical raw bytes into Line 1 (Alphabet) and =yencryption (32 lowercase hex characters).
behaviors.penne_behavior: Extracts Line 1 salt and =yencryption salt, asserting `yenc_params.salt == session.salt()`. Fails closed on mismatch.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Extracts Line 1 salt via `extract_salt_from_line1` and =yencryption salt via `parse_yencryption_line`, asserting exact byte equality. Fails closed on mismatch.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Extracts Line 1 salt and parses =yencryption salt, asserting `memcmp(line1Salt, yencSalt, 16) == 0`. Fails closed on mismatch.
accepted_forms: Identical 16 raw byte values between Line 1 Alphabet-encoded salt and =yencryption hex-encoded salt
rejected_forms: Mismatched salt bytes between Line 1 and =yencryption
Missing salt in either header when combined encryption is active
behaviors.security_impact: Prevents key/nonce desynchronization and dual-context tampering between header and body cryptographic domains.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 3 & 4 / yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard Section 3 & 4

behaviors.name: Strict Canonical Four-Token =yencryption Grammar
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Shows '=yencryption cipher=XChaCha20-Poly1305 salt=<hex> tag=<hex>' without explicitly forbidding reordering, extra tokens, or uppercase hex.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Emits strict canonical format `=yencryption cipher=XChaCha20-Poly1305 salt=<32_lower_hex> tag=<32_lower_hex>` with exactly 4 tokens and lowercase hex.
behaviors.penne_behavior: `parse_yencryption_line` enforces 4 tokens, exact token keys in order, exact length 32, and lowercase hex `[0-9a-f]`. Rejects uppercase, duplicate, or extra tokens.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: `parse_yencryption_line` strictly checks 4 tokens, exact key prefixes, lowercase hex, and 32-character lengths. Rejects malformed headers.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: `ParseYEncryptionHeader` enforces 4 whitespace-separated tokens, exact key names in order, lowercase hex, and rejects extra/missing tokens.
rejected_forms: Uppercase hex [0-9A-F]
Extra parameters (e.g. version=1.0, len=...)
Reordered parameters (e.g. salt before cipher, tag before salt)
Duplicate parameters
Missing parameters
Non-32 character hex string length
behaviors.security_impact: Prevents parser differential vulnerabilities, parameter injection, and ambiguity in cryptographic header processing.

behaviors.name: Single-Part Article Header Placement at Physical Line 2
behaviors.current_spec_wording: States =yencryption is inserted after =ybegin line. Does not specify physical line ordinal.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Emits `=yencryption` immediately after `=ybegin` on physical line 2 (lineIndex = 2) for single-part articles.
behaviors.penne_behavior: `extract_and_remove_yencryption` enforces `=yencryption` is on physical line 2 in single-part articles and rejects if found on any other line.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: `extract_and_remove_yencryption` validates line 2 starts with `=yencryption` for single-part articles and rejects placement anywhere else.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: `ExtractAndRemoveYEncryption` validates line 2 is `=yencryption` for single-part articles and rejects duplicate or misplaced lines.
accepted_forms: Physical line 2 immediately after =ybegin line 1 for single-part yEnc
rejected_forms: =yencryption before =ybegin
=yencryption at line 3+ in single-part articles
Duplicate =yencryption lines anywhere in article
behaviors.security_impact: Ensures deterministic stream parsing without backtracking or scanning untrusted data lines for control commands.

behaviors.name: Multipart Article Header Placement at Physical Line 3
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Does not distinguish multipart placement from single-part placement.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Emits `=yencryption` immediately after `=ypart` on physical line 3 (lineIndex = 3) for multipart articles.
behaviors.penne_behavior: `extract_and_remove_yencryption` enforces line 1 `=ybegin`, line 2 `=ypart`, and line 3 `=yencryption` for multipart articles.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: `extract_and_remove_yencryption` validates line 1 is `=ybegin` (with `part=`), line 2 is `=ypart`, and line 3 is `=yencryption`.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: `ExtractAndRemoveYEncryption` validates multipart sequence line 1 `=ybegin`, line 2 `=ypart`, line 3 `=yencryption`.
accepted_forms: Physical line 3 immediately after =ypart line 2 for multipart yEnc
rejected_forms: =yencryption between =ybegin and =ypart (line 2 in multipart)
=yencryption at line 4+ in multipart articles
=ypart missing when part= declared in =ybegin
behaviors.security_impact: Preserves standard yEnc multipart header grouping while maintaining deterministic control line indexing.

behaviors.name: Ciphertext Wire CRC Verification and Downstream Plaintext CRC Clearing
behaviors.current_spec_wording: States CRC is calculated during yEnc encoding; does not specify that wire CRCs cover ciphertext and must be stripped before downstream PAR2/assembly.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Calculates standard yEnc pcrc32 / crc32 over ciphertext data lines during wire encoding.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Verifies wire CRC against ciphertext prior to AEAD decryption. After Poly1305 authentication succeeds, sets `part_crc32 = None` and `file_crc32 = None` on plaintext handoff.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Verifies yEnc wire CRC against ciphertext in `sabctools.decode_yenc`, verifies AEAD tag, then sets `article.crc32 = None` to prevent assembler discarding authenticated plaintext.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Decodes yEnc ciphertext and verifies wire CRC in `Decoder.cpp`, verifies AEAD tag in `YEncDecryptor.cpp`, and marks article CRC verified/cleared for downstream `ArticleWriter`.
accepted_forms: Valid wire CRC matching ciphertext followed by AEAD tag authentication
rejected_forms: Wire CRC mismatch on ciphertext (treated as corrupt article)
Passing ciphertext wire CRC to plaintext PAR2 checkers as expected plaintext CRC
behaviors.security_impact: Ensures transit corruptions are caught early via CRC while preventing valid authenticated plaintexts from failing downstream assembly.

behaviors.name: Two-Tier Error Classification: Retriable Provider Corruption vs Fatal Structural Rejection
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Classifies failures by input source: pre-fetch NZB metadata or local configuration is structural; fetched article bytes are provider corruption.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Fails synchronously on invalid input or encoding setup with zero output emitted.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Maps Poly1305 authentication failures and wire CRC mismatches to retriable server errors (triggering backup NNTP failover). Maps missing `segmentIndex` or invalid XML to fatal download errors.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Raises `BadArticleCrypto` (mapped to `ARTICLE_CORRUPT`) on AEAD authentication failure to trigger multi-server failover. Structural errors fail the NZB immediately.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Sets `ArticleStatus::FAILED` on AEAD / CRC failure (triggering backup news server retry). Missing NZB identity or malformed syntax fails the job immediately.
accepted_forms: Clean article passing all structural and cryptographic checks
rejected_forms: Corrupted ciphertext or tampered tag: retriable provider corruption
Malformed, missing, misplaced, or duplicate fetched control lines: retriable provider corruption
Missing segmentIndex, malformed XML, duplicate index, or missing password: fatal structural rejection
behaviors.security_impact: Maximizes download resilience against transient NNTP server corruption while preventing unrecoverable infinite retry loops on structural errors.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 7 / yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard Section 7

behaviors.name: Strict Zero-Output Guarantee on Cryptographic and Structural Failure
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Authentication failure results in complete decryption failure with no partial data output.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Guarantees no encoded article is emitted on key/nonce derivation or encryption failure.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Aborts immediately on authentication failure; releases 0 bytes of plaintext or partial buffer to assembler or disk.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: On any decryption or authentication error, discards buffer (`article.data = b""`) and releases 0 bytes downstream.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Discards cache buffer on AEAD tag verification failure; writes 0 bytes to disk.
accepted_forms: Zero bytes written to target destination or cache on any authentication failure
rejected_forms: Partial plaintext release
Leaking ciphertext into plaintext target files on decrypt failure
behaviors.security_impact: Cryptographic integrity guarantee: unauthenticated plaintext is never exposed to users or downstream parsers.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 5 & 7 / yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard Section 5 & 7

behaviors.name: Explicit NZB segmentIndex Attribute Validation and Derivation Anchoring
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Defines segmentIndex range 1..=4294967295, shortest decimal representation, no leading zeroes.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Emits monotonic 1-based segmentIndex attributes across all segments in the NZB session.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Validates segmentIndex syntax (1..=4294967295, shortest decimal, no leading zeroes), rejects duplicates, and keys nonce derivation strictly by segmentIndex.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Parses and validates segmentIndex in `nzbparser.py`, stores on `Article.segment_index`, rejects duplicates, and derives nonces without file arithmetic.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Parses segmentIndex in `NzbFile.cpp`, stores on `ArticleInfo::m_segmentIndex`, rejects duplicates, and derives nonces strictly from explicit index.
accepted_forms: Unqualified attribute segmentIndex="1" through segmentIndex="4294967295" with no leading zeroes or whitespace
rejected_forms: segmentIndex="0"
segmentIndex="01" (leading zero)
segmentIndex="+1" / "-1"
segmentIndex="4294967296" (u32 overflow)
Duplicate segmentIndex values in same NZB
Missing segmentIndex when yenc_encrypted is true
behaviors.security_impact: Prevents nonce reuse across segments and ensures deterministic decryption regardless of NNTP fetch order or XML rearrangement.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 8 / yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard Section 8

behaviors.name: Complete NNTP Presentation Metadata Decoupling
behaviors.current_spec_wording: <file subject>, NNTP Subject header, XML file order, and segment order have no cryptographic meaning.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Can randomize or obfuscate NNTP subjects and file tags without altering explicit segmentIndex derivation.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Derives cryptographic parameters solely from NZB password and segmentIndex; completely ignores NNTP Subject headers.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Ignores NNTP subjects for decryption; anchors filename reconstruction to NZB file metadata or deobfuscator.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Ignores NNTP subjects for decryption; anchors cryptographic pipeline strictly to NzbFile explicit indices.
accepted_forms: Random / obfuscated NNTP Subject headers and filenames
rejected_forms: Attempting to derive segment numbering from NNTP subject regex or file sequence
behaviors.security_impact: Eliminates subject parsing vulnerabilities, allows total Usenet metadata obfuscation, and prevents spoofing attacks via subject manipulation.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 7 & 8 / yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard Section 7 & 8

behaviors.name: Dot-Unstuffed Physical Line Counting and CRLF/Bare-LF Normalization
behaviors.current_spec_wording:
Line counting on physical lines 1..N. Line endings CRLF (
). Does not explicitly document NNTP dot-unstuffing boundary.
behaviors.pesto_behavior:
Emits CRLF (
) on all lines. Line count is physical line count.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Applies decryption to dot-unstuffed article body. Splits lines preserving endings, strips trailing , increments lineIndex per physical line, accepts CRLF and bare LF.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior:
Operates on dot-unstuffed body from NNTP layer. Splits with `keepends=True`, handles `
` and bare `
` uniformly, increments lineIndex per line.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior:
Operates on dot-unstuffed body. Parses lines scanning for `
` with optional ``, increments lineIndex per physical line.
rejected_forms: Evaluating lineIndex prior to NNTP dot-unstuffing
behaviors.security_impact: Prevents line counter desynchronization between encoder and decoder when articles pass through NNTP transport servers.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Control Lines Encryption Standard Section 2 & 5

behaviors.name: Article-Bounded Streaming Memory Execution Model
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Requires O(article_size) working memory and prohibits whole-file or whole-release accumulation; observed article sizes are non-normative guidance.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Streams chunks from disk/file, allocating buffers proportional to article size (~768 KiB), constant memory O(article_size).
behaviors.penne_behavior: Downloads and decrypts article buffers in memory up to max article size (~8 MiB), writes decrypted plaintext directly to target slice.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Processes articles in worker threads with article-sized memory buffers (~8 MiB limit). Rejects oversized articles.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Allocates article buffer in memory cache (~4 MiB connection limit) and writes direct to disk.
accepted_forms: Working memory proportional to one article, O(article_size)
Typical configured article sizes from 128 KiB through 4 MiB
rejected_forms: Accumulating a complete multipart file or release in memory
Articles above a client's configured local safety limit, which may be up to 8 MiB in the reference implementations
behaviors.security_impact: Protects download clients against memory exhaustion / denial of service attacks from maliciously crafted huge articles.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 9 (Interoperability/Implementation Notes)

behaviors.name: Unmodified Plain yEnc Fast-Path Compatibility
behaviors.current_spec_wording: Mentions compatibility with existing yEnc parsers.
behaviors.pesto_behavior: Emits standard yEnc when encryption flags are not supplied.
behaviors.penne_behavior: Bypasses crypto layer completely when `meta.yenc_encrypted` is false; decodes standard yEnc with native performance.
behaviors.sabnzbd_behavior: Dispatches to native C extension `sabctools.decode_yenc` directly for unencrypted jobs with zero crypto overhead.
behaviors.nzbget_behavior: Bypasses `YEncDecryptor` and invokes standard `Decoder::Decode` directly when `m_yencEncryptedMeta` is false.
accepted_forms: Unencrypted standard yEnc 1.3 single-part and multipart articles
rejected_forms: Attempting transport decryption on unencrypted articles
behaviors.security_impact: Ensures download clients remain 100% backward-compatible with the global Usenet archive of unencrypted releases.
behaviors.spec_target: yEnc Body Encryption Standard Section 9 / README.md
